adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the mapping that builds reference payloads was changed from `credentialId: isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`. This is a concrete behavior change visible in the diff: for non-calendar results (e.g., video integrations) any `result.credentialId` is now discarded, whereas previously it was propagated. If downstream logic relies on `credentialId` to associate the created reference with the correct integration credential (especially when multiple credentials of the same type exist), this will break updates/deletes for those non-calendar references.
